title: Briston W.5444 Memorial

external_narratives.summary: Detailed account of Wellington W5444 PH-T piloted by Fl/Lt Charles Norman McVeigh AFC of 12 Squadron. Returning from a mission to Cologne on 16/17 August 1941, the starboard engine was damaged by flak. McVeigh attempted an emergency landing near Briston but crashed into a railway bridge after mistaking railway signal lights for an aerodrome.
key_details: Starboard engine damaged by flak over Cologne
